card.name: Linking words before foods and drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (including, such as, or, with, before, of) and the word fresh, right before a food, meal or drug name is expected. Seen in food lists and in dosing or administration instructions.

modes.label: Food lists
modes.description: The word fresh or a linking word like including or such as introduces healthy foods or snacks.
modes.example: healthier alternatives<< including>> fresh apples, pumpkin sauce and frozen yogurt

modes.label: Dosing instructions
modes.description: A linking word or part of a drug name comes before a meal, drink or second drug in administration directions.
modes.example: taken at the same time each day with food or<< a>> milky drink.

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: The first syllable of levetiracetam or levothyroxine after a list or with.
modes.example: valproic acid or<< le>>vetiracetam) prior to Bus

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may favor words like fresh in the output.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a food or drug is named.
